description.value:
Starting at 6th level, the damage dealt by your class features are considered magical for the purposes of overcoming resistance to nonmagical attacks and damage.

Foundry note: damage parts from Hurricane Strike, Destructive Tornado, Rage Tornado, Electrify and similar features should be flagged as magical on use; with Midi-QOL this can be automated via the flags.midi-qol.damage.magical flag.
